message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV/text files and passes data directly to tokenizers without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: Pretrained models are loaded via HuggingFace Hub (e.g., 'bert-base-uncased') with no checksum verification, pinned commits, or authentication checks.

No detected label flipping detection: The code maps raw labels to integers (e.g., NEU→1, NEG→2, else→0) but performs no validation against an expected label set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool is used.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset loaders read CSV/text files and tokenize samples directly with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs applied to the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via torch.load(opts.pretrained) and from_pretrained('bert-base-uncased') without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard AdamW with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The evaluation uses sklearn's classification_report for accuracy and F1, but there is no held-out test set isolation enforcement, data hashing/signing, or use of multiple independent metric sources to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference function directly computes a mask from raw inputs and passes them to the model without any shape, range, type, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: The inference function applies np.argmax to raw logits and returns results without any NaN checks, probability sanity bounds, or threshold guards.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text, it is a sentiment classification model (not an LLM text-generation model), and no input filtering, content moderation, or injection detection is present.
